description: Research Part 1 public outcomes and direct producer inputs. Original offline v1.22 character 3 is the saved highest-level reference. Saved EXP, partial Insight EXP, and save time use retained original startup input, not warmed runtime values. Getter refreshes use original supported arguments. Extraction alone does not prove relevant-state pairing.
target: Research account progress, discoveries, lenses, Insight, hourly production, offline gains, Papers, and Posty Notes

pairingEvidence.source: Original Jelly_Operator v1.22, isolated offline port 3101, character 3 Sludgev4.
pairingEvidence.originalInput: GET /cloud-save matched all 799 retained latest.json keys after JSON decoding. No offline fixture export occurred.
pairingEvidence.savedProgress: Use the original input for EXP, partial Insight EXP, and TimeAway.GlobalTime. Current runtime EXP and partial Insight advanced.
pairingEvidence.progressAndAllowance: Reference level 70, requirement 13333054299.729195, name, Research found flags, Insight levels, remaining attempts, pending seconds, Grid levels/Shapes, and failed-roll option 514 match.
pairingEvidence.lensesAndRates: All saved lens tuples match. Original MagnifiersOwned is 14. All 14 lenses in the owned prefix are placed; later saved slots are reserved, not unplaced owned lenses. Original allocation and drawing callers use this owned prefix. Research Grid inputs, Emporium ownership, and Jelly obstruction ownership match. Partial Insight EXP does not feed rate or requirement helpers.
pairingEvidence.ownedCardsAndEquipment: All Cards[0].h counts match Cards0. Cards[1] matches Cards1. Reference equipped Cards[2] matches CardEquip_3. EquipmentOrder matches EquipOrder_3 after original array-object normalization.
pairingEvidence.companions: Current CompanionBon and CompanionLVz entries match retained companion ownership and level-two context. Option 606 is empty. No token-active branch is observed.
pairingEvidence.gamingAndSailing: TotemInfo, Gaming, Lab, Sailing, and Cards1 match. Actor481._GenINFO[114] and raw best-wave sum both equal 1170. Raw Slab registrations equal 1642.
pairingEvidence.externalExpAndRewards: Grimoire, Dream, FarmRank, FarmUpg, FarmCrop, Cooking, Meals, ArcadeUpg, Summon, Ninja, Jars, Arcane, and relevant Holes inputs match after original numeric-string normalization. Spelunk shop/ownership/Lore/epilogue rows and Sushi discovery rows match. Royal Outpost selection is unchanged and not Research.
pairingEvidence.tomeConsumedInputs: Original Actor229 TomeQTY consumes unchanged Spelunk rows 1/2/5/6/13/46, Bubba[1][8], Refinery rank rows 3..8[1], and Research[7][4/9]. It does not consume the observed drift in active delve progress, Bubba Currency, Refinery timers, or partial Insight.
pairingEvidence.tomePlayerAndAccountInputs: All 38 directly referenced account options match. All six Tasks rows, reference statues, stars, prayers, inventory, kills, Currency and family inputs match. All-player levels and quests match. Seven characters differ at talent 625, but every account-wide talent maximum consumed by Tome matches.
pairingEvidence.tomeCacheConsistency: Current Actor229._GenInfo[84] and DNSM.TomeQTYtot equal 44060. The sum of all 122 original Summoning TomePTS helper results also equals 44060. No cache value was fabricated or replaced.
pairingEvidence.GambitDeathnoteInputs: All 12 KLA_i keys and Rift match the retained save after JSON decoding. Original cached and fresh Deathnote ranks for worlds 0..6 both equal [300,220,280,260,260,280,460], totaling 2060. No save inputs were modified.
pairingEvidence.refreshArguments: Refresh discoveries and total Insight levels with argument -1. Refresh Kaleidoscope support with argument 999 before rates. Refresh epilogues with index -1 before shared EXP.
pairingEvidence.observedBranches: Found and missing Observations, unmet Research levels, zero and positive Insight levels, placed EXP/Insight/support lenses, reserved lens slots, no support including diagonal candidates, multiple support, reached/upcoming notes, inactive Prehistoric set, permanent Troll set, non-Research selected Outpost, unlocked and locked outside rewards, and capped offline gains.
pairingEvidence.unobservedBranches: Owned unplaced lenses, exhausted attempts, insufficient maximum roll, simultaneous discovery blockers, Kaleidoscopes placed at row edges, nonzero pending seconds, a tie for highest saved Research level, a missing saved EXP requirement, token-active companions, equipped-only complete sets, selected Research Outpost, saturated lens/Shape/card/artifact caps, capped failed-roll pity, disabled Research Superbits, and Research Superbit 44 enabled without general Totalizer Superbit 7. Current Superbits 7, 44, and 34 are enabled.
pairingEvidence.exactRuntimeDrift: EXP 986717522.1121395 versus saved 986707491.1282617. Partial Insight indices 17 and 22 each advanced by 0.0055951875001. Research[7][5], active Spelunk[3][6] and [4][2], Sushi[4], CookMaster EXP, Bubba Currency, Refinery timers, and unrelated account options differ. Saved-state comparisons do not use those warmed values.
pairingEvidence.limits: Input pairing and original helper extraction alone do not prove website parity. At extraction, no website tests, builds, lint, formatters, live parity, reset, time advance, gameplay action, or fixture refresh ran. The current handoff records subsequent integrated checks.
exploratoryExpressionFailures: Object.keys(idleon): sandbox Object was undefined. Reflect.ownKeys on the source prototype worked.
ActorEvents_579._customBlock_Thingies.toString(): direct global was undefined. The original scripts registry path worked.
idleon.listFunctions(): TypeError, helper does not exist. idleon.listScripts() worked.
idleon.findFunction("Inventory") and idleon.findFunction("ItemQuantity"): Function not found. Paper inventory comparisons use the matched original saved inventory input.
Holes/GambitTotalScore was not a source selector and returned the generic fallback 69. Source inspection found GambitPts with argument 777. Correct extraction returned 4104954.3765447172.
Final individual extraction: 128 successful results, zero request or expression errors.
